sources.snippet: One of my papers, Caging in Time, has recently been accepted by International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR). I built XLeRobot as a personal hobby to instantiate my research theory, also to provide a low-cost platform for people who are interested in robotics and embodied AI to work with.
